title: Slippery smooth, but pretty.
text: Slippery smooth, but pretty.. Sturdy, and easy to clean. But the " lips" are smooth and slippery. With the weight, even empty, it feels as if it all might easily slip out of your hand. I'm going to try to find a more abrasive tape to put under the top lip, to make it feel more secure.

product_metadata.title: DOWAN 20 OZ Ceramic Soup Bowls & Cereal Bowls - White Bowls Set of 6 for Kitchen - Bowls for Cereal, Soup, Oatmeal, Rice, Pasta, Salad - Dishwasher & Microwave Safe
features: Versatile Cereal Bowl - Deep and lightweight 20 oz bowls for kitchen (5.5-inch width), the perfect choice for cereal, dessert, nuts even snack, soup, ice cream bowls and rice bowls. These white cereal bowls suitable for family dinners, food storage, breakfast oatmeal, restaurant service, party sauces, and holiday gifts.

User-friendly Flared Design - The edge of the cereal bowls is flared to prevent food spillage. And the bottom of these white bowls comes with a sturdy base allows you secure the grip with comfortable touch for easy holding hot or cold items in your hand. The innovative lip design also makes it easy to drink soup.
Lightweight and Durable - With lightweight and compact design，these ceramic cereal bowls are light to hold even for kids.

Easy to Clean & Space Saving - Ceramic bowls are microwave, dishwasher, oven, and refrigerator safe. The nearly-nonstick enameled glazed surface of this bowl is easy to clean. The deep and round-shaped bowl set offer conveniently stackable design for compact storage in a cupboard or hutch, make much room for your other dinnerware in the kitchen cupboard.

Original Design and Attractive Gift - Cereal bowls set of 6 designed by Dowan with a glossy and smooth finish, perfect for daily household use, halloween party or as a gorgeous gift for your loved ones on special occasions, such as birthday, house warming, wedding anniversary or other holidays.
